rules.name: Verified SLA & Uptime Guarantees
rules.guideline_text: Never promise '100% uptime', 'zero downtime', or '99.999%' without explicit Legal and Enterprise SLA addendum. Our verified standard SLA is 99.95% (99.99% for Enterprise Tier).
rules.rationale: Exaggerated SLA guarantees expose the company to breach-of-contract lawsuits and enterprise penalty claims.
rules.suggested_fix: verified 99.95% standard SLA (up to 99.99% with Enterprise SLA addendum)

rules.name: Verified Global Infrastructure & Regions
rules.guideline_text: Only cite audited infrastructure metrics. Do not claim global availability 'in every single country' or 'infinite regions'. Our infrastructure is deployed across 42 certified edge regions.
pattern_or_terms: in every country in the world
rules.rationale: False infrastructure claims fail technical due diligence with prospective enterprise buyers.
rules.suggested_fix: deployed across 42 certified global edge regions

rules.name: Audited Latency Benchmarks
rules.guideline_text: Sub-millisecond claims must be qualified by geographical cache proximity. Replace blanket '<1ms latency everywhere' with verified '<10ms p95 edge latency'.
rules.rationale: Blanket sub-millisecond promises are physically unverifiable and damage technical credibility with CTOs.
rules.suggested_fix: consistent sub-10ms p95 edge latency across major metros

rules.name: Certified Security Standards
rules.guideline_text: Do not use marketing jargon like 'military-grade zero-hack encryption' or 'completely unhackable'. State accurate accreditations: AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, and SOC 2 Type II compliance.
rules.rationale: Security regulatory bodies and ISO auditors penalize absolutist claims of invulnerability.
rules.suggested_fix: enterprise AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, and SOC 2 Type II certified infrastructure

rules.name: Absolutist & Hyperbolic Tone
rules.guideline_section: Section 1.2 — Brand Voice: Confident, Measured, Authoritative
rules.guideline_text: Inkloom's brand voice is evidence-backed and sophisticated. Avoid empty superlatives like 'the world's greatest', 'miracle cure', 'revolutionary game-changer without equal'.
rules.rationale: Hyperbolic copy undermines institutional trust and repels discerning enterprise decision makers.

rules.name: High-Pressure Clickbait & Fear-Driven Copy
rules.guideline_text: Avoid aggressive countdown panics, fear-of-missing-out manipulations, or condescending phrases like 'you'd be foolish not to' or 'act before you get left behind forever'.
pattern_or_terms: act before you get left behind forever
shocking secret they don't want you to know
buy right now or regret it
rules.rationale: Aggressive sales pressure cheapens the brand and conflicts with enterprise consultative selling.
rules.suggested_fix: discover how modern teams elevate governance with measurable ROI

rules.name: Informal Slang & Colloquialisms
rules.guideline_text: Maintain professional polish in external communications. Prohibit casual slang terms like 'no cap', 'bruh', 'literally insane', 'vibes only' in corporate releases.
rules.rationale: Slang alienates international executive audiences and reduces brand authority.

rules.name: Deprecated Product Names
rules.guideline_text: Legacy product names 'Inkloom Classic', 'Inkloom v1', and 'CloudStack Pro' have been sunset. Always use 'Inkloom Enterprise Platform' or 'Inkloom AI Studio'.
rules.rationale: Referencing sunset brand names confuses customers and causes licensing ambiguities.

rules.name: Non-Inclusive Technical Terminology
rules.guideline_text: Adopt modern inclusive technical terminology: replace 'master/slave' with 'primary/replica' or 'control/worker'; replace 'whitelist/blacklist' with 'allowlist/blocklist'.
rules.rationale: Outdated terminology fails DEI compliance standards and corporate governance audits.

rules.name: Prohibited Competitor Disparagement
rules.guideline_text: Never disparage competitors with subjective insults like 'AWS is clunky and slow' or 'Datadog is a ripoff'. Focus strictly on our affirmative architectural advantages.
rules.rationale: Defamatory competitor attacks expose the company to Lanham Act false-advertising and libel liability.
rules.suggested_fix: traditional legacy cloud architectures requiring complex manual tuning

rules.name: Third-Party Trademark Attribution
rules.guideline_section: Section 2.7 — Third-Party Brand & Social Platform Citations
rules.guideline_text: When referencing Twitter, cite modern attribution: 'X (formerly Twitter)'. Do not use obsolete standalone Twitter trademark.
rules.rationale: Proper attribution ensures trademark respect and partner compliance.

rules.name: Brand Color Palette Alignment
rules.guideline_text: Primary graphics must utilize Inkloom's certified primary palette: Primary Indigo (#6366F1), Deep Slate (#0F172A), Accent Emerald (#10B981), and Neutral Canvas (#F8FAFC).
rules.rationale: Uncontrolled color variation dilutes brand recognition across digital touchpoints.
rules.suggested_fix: align color fills with #6366F1 and #0F172A brand standards

rules.name: WCAG Accessibility Alt-Text Standard
rules.guideline_section: Section 3.4 — Digital Accessibility & Inclusive Design (WCAG 2.1 AA)
rules.guideline_text: All visual assets must feature meaningful descriptive alternative text (>25 characters). Generic phrases like 'image', 'graphic', or file names 'screenshot.png' are strictly prohibited.
rules.rationale: Missing or low-quality alt-text violates ADA / Section 508 legal compliance standards.
rules.suggested_fix: detailed descriptive alt-text explaining key chart data and visual context

documents.title: Architecture Overview: Multi-Tenant Data Isolation & Fault Tolerance
documents.author: Utkarsh Yadav
documents.content:
Inkloom Enterprise Platform leverages a high-throughput master/slave database topology combined with strict access controls.

All sensitive telemetry is sanitized against a dynamic blacklist and dummy data generation harness. By pairing custom kernel drivers with our core protocol, the platform delivers instantaneous 0ms responses across verified clusters.

Furthermore, our multi-region storage layer provides a completely unhackable vault verified across independent pen-tests.
